title: Domain-Routed Delta Optimization for Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2611.13249v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation assigns each sample a domain teacher but typically updates shared student parameters. We introduce Domain-Routed Delta Optimization (DRD-MOPD), which specifies which parameter components each domain's samples update. The student is the sum of a frozen base and trainable components initialized from expert-minus-base weights. All components participate in every forward pass; four update modes define the correspondence between sample domains and components, each with independent optimizer states. We analyze these update rules and measure retention of the original expert geometry through angles, projection coefficients, and energy. Prior work such as Open-MOPD distills directly from the base model; 97.02% of its released final checkpoint's increment energy lies outside the span of the original expert directions. In comparison, our Own checkpoint after 20 updates retains coefficients near one along each

translated_title: 面向多教师在线蒸馏的域路由增量优化
translated_abstract: 多教师在线蒸馏为每个样本分配一个领域教师，但通常更新共享的学生参数。我们提出了域路由增量优化（DRD-MOPD），它明确规定了每个领域的样本应更新哪些参数组件。学生模型是冻结的基础模型与可训练组件之和，这些可训练组件由“专家模型减去基础模型”的权重差初始化。所有组件都参与每一次前向传播；四种更新模式定义了样本领域与组件之间的对应关系，且每种模式拥有独立的优化器状态。我们分析了这些更新规则，并通过角度、投影系数和能量来衡量对原始专家几何结构的保留程度。先前的工作（如 Open-MOPD）直接从基础模型进行蒸馏；其发布的最终检查点中，97.02% 的增量能量位于原始专家方向的张成空间之外。相比之下，我们的 Own 检查点在经过 20 次更新后，在每个方向上仍保持接近于一的投影系数……
tldr: 本文提出域路由增量优化方法（DRD-MOPD），通过为不同领域的样本指定各自更新的参数组件（以专家模型与基础模型的权重差初始化），在多教师在线蒸馏中显著保留原始专家的几何结构。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Domain-Routed Delta Optimization (DRD-MOPD), which specifies which parameter components each domain's samples update—initialized from expert-minus-base weights—thereby substantially preserving the original expert geometry in multi-teacher on-policy distillation.
